title: The Hidden Listeners Who Believed
intro: In the stillness of a sacred gathering, a remarkable assembly arrived from an unseen realm. Drawn by whispers of something wondrous, they listened to recitation that would seal their fate forever. Their testimony remains one of the most unique in divine scripture.
clues: We are beings from a realm unseen by most, and we came as a group.
We journeyed toward a gathering to hear something remarkable.
When we arrived, we listened to a recitation that left us amazed.
We openly acknowledged that some among us are righteous and some are not.
We knew we could not escape the divine decree on earth, nor by flight into the sky.
When we heard the guidance, we believed in it; whoever believes in their Lord will not fear loss or burden.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Building lofty pillars in our city
Being destroyed for killing our prophets

location.label: Key Element
options: A sacred cave in the mountains

outcome.label: Outcome
options: We believed and warned our people
Destroyed by a mighty blast from the sky
Punished by a scorching, destructive wind
outcome.answer: We believed and warned our people

arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
verse: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways. (72:11)
